description: This XML file defines simple methods for accounting transaction management within the OFBiz framework, including posting, updating, deleting, and calculating account transactions and related entries.

methods.name: checkAcctgTransPosted
methods.description: Checks whether an accounting transaction (AcctgTrans) has already been posted by verifying its 'isPosted' status.

methods.name: updateAcctgTransLastModified
methods.description: Updates the 'lastModifiedByUserLogin' and related info for an AcctgTrans record.

methods.name: createAcctgTransEntry
methods.description: Creates a new accounting transaction entry, setting default currency and amount values, and ensuring the transaction is not already posted.

methods.name: updateAcctgTransEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing AcctgTransEntry, ensuring that only status changes are allowed if the transaction is already posted.

methods.name: deleteAcctgTransEntry
methods.description: Removes an AcctgTransEntry, only if the parent transaction has not been posted.

methods.name: calculateAcctgTransTrialBalance
methods.description: Calculates the debit and credit totals, as well as the difference, for a specific AcctgTrans to verify balanced entries.

methods.name: postAcctgTrans
methods.description: Posts an AcctgTrans, performing various validation checks including trial balance and scheduled posting date, then marks it as posted.

methods.name: getAcctgTransEntriesAndTransTotal
methods.description: Calculates totals for debit and credit entries associated with an accounting transaction, across associated parties.

methods.name: calculateGlAccountTrialBalance
methods.description: Calculates the trial balance for a general ledger account, summing debit and credit amounts for posted or unposted transactions.

methods.name: revertAcctgTransOnRemovePaymentApplications
methods.description: Creates reverse accounting transactions when PaymentApplication records are removed, to revert previous postings.

methods.name: revertAcctgTransOnCancelInvoice
methods.description: Reverts accounting transactions related to an invoice upon cancellation, creating reverse entries.
